papers.title_en: Modular and Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search with Vectorium and kANNolo
papers.authors: Silvio Martinico, Franco Maria Nardini, Cosimo Rulli, Rossano Venturini
papers.evidence: 面向向量检索的模块化索引与量化ANN搜索库
papers.tldr: 面向稠密、稀疏与多向量嵌入的近似最近邻检索，现有库常固定索引、相似度与量化组合，难以覆盖全部表示。Vectorium 将向量、距离、量化器与数据集解耦并提供 11 种编码器，kANNolo 在其上实现泛化的 HNSW、IVF 与两阶段重排索引。编译期特化使模块化无运行开销，并在稠密与稀疏基准上取得领先的内存-吞吐权衡。该工作以两个 Rust 开源库统一了 ANN 设计空间，兼顾效率与可组合性。
papers.abstract_en:
Approximate Nearest Neighbors (ANN) search over neural embeddings powers modern retrieval systems such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Embeddings come in three representations (dense, sparse and multi-vector), and efficient search combines an index structure, a similarity function and a quantization scheme. Existing libraries fix one combination, hard-code each one separately, or factor only one side of the problem, and none covers all three representations. We present Vectorium and kANNolo, two open-source Rust libraries that split this design space into a data-management layer and an indexing layer. Vectorium abstracts the vector, the distance function, the quantizer and the dataset independently, and provides 11 encoders, from 32-bit floats to sub-bit codes. On top of it, kANNolo implements Hierarchical Navigable Small-World (HNSW) graph and Inverted Vector File (IVF) indexes that are generic over representation, encoder and metric, and a two-stage index that composes any first-stage index with any rescoring dataset. Since every combination is specialized at compile time, this modularity adds no run-time overhead, and the resulting indexes reach state-of-the-art performance: our Product Quantization matches Faiss in accuracy at competitive speed, our RaBitQ and HNSW match or outperform their reference implementations, and our IVF outperforms Faiss. Against six dense and five sparse systems on seven public collections, our indexes give the best memory-throughput trade-off on dense data in 9 of 12 collection-accuracy pairs and perform well on out-of-distribution queries. On sparse data, the systems built on Vectorium lead on all three collections, with Seismic and SeismicWave the fastest and kANNolo's indexes the most compact.

---

papers.title_en: Turbocharging PiPNN for Proximity and $k$-NN Graph Building
papers.authors: Tobias Rubel, Richard Wen, Guy Blelloch, Laxman Dhulipala, Lars Gottesbüren, Jakub Łącki, Vahab Mirrokni
papers.evidence: 加速图式ANNS的邻近图与k-NN图构建
papers.tldr: 图基 ANNS 索引查询快但构建慢，PiPNN 曾用分块与稠密矩阵乘加速建索引。本文提出 PiPNN II 与 GPU 版 GPiPNN，结合量化、低精度矩阵运算及融合 top-K 核，并扩展到高质量 k-NN 图构建。结果建索引最高提速 8 倍，GPiPNN 比 Jasper/CAGRA 快 43.7/50 倍，10-NN@90% 召回在 CPU/GPU 分别提速 13/6.6 倍。十亿级 10-NN 图可在 16 分钟内完成，显著加速聚类与异常检测等下游任务。
papers.abstract_en:
Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) indexes such as HNSW and Vamana deliver state-of-the-art query performance at the cost of large indexing times. The recently introduced PiPNN method drastically accelerated index construction by way of a partitioning-based algorithm leveraging dense matrix multiplication and top-$K$ aggregation kernels.   In this paper, we unlock the full potential of PiPNN's hardware-friendly algorithm design. We introduce PiPNN II, which optimizes multiple steps of the PiPNN recipe, giving up to $8\times$ speedups for graph-based ANNS index construction. In addition, we present GPiPNN, a GPU implementation which builds comparable ANNS indices up to $43.7\times$ faster than Jasper and up to $50\times$ faster than CAGRA. We also extend PiPNN II and GPiPNN to compute high-quality $k$-NN graphs directly, which unlocks massive speedups over methods used in many existing systems for clustering, anomaly detection, and more. For 10-NN graph building at $90\%$ recall, we obtain up to a $13\times$ speedup on CPUs and $6.6\times$ on GPUs as compared to the prior best methods. PiPNN II can build a billion-scale 10-NN graph in under 16 minutes.   Common to both PiPNN II and GPiPNN is the use of quantization to reduce memory traffic and leverage fast low-precision matrix operations. Top-$K$ emerges as a new bottleneck, which we optimize with specialized code for specific $K$, and by fusing with the matrix kernel to avoid materializing the distance matrix to memory. On CPUs, we demonstrate further performance improvements by leveraging our matrix kernels in the RobustPrune procedure proposed in Vamana and used in PiPNN. On GPUs, we flatten recursive partitioning into segmented batches, use one fused top-$K$ abstraction for partitioning and leaf scoring, and prune with already-witnessed direct edges rather than new candidate-to-candidate scoring passes.

---

papers.title_en: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use
papers.authors: Changran Xu, Zeju Li, Qiang Xu
papers.evidence: 在使用点评估智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 现有任务成功率、检索质量和成本无法说明LLM agent是否真正使用了交付的记忆，也无法反映使用后的后果。MemUse在记录轨迹的“使用点”评估记忆：逐条比较交付内容与agent已可见信息，并沿后续动作及其后果追踪影响，再由agentic judge从相关性、准确性、新颖性、影响和观察效果评分。基于8000个SWE-bench Verified片段和三种记忆系统，解决率与无记忆基线相差不超过0.4个百分点，但多数交付条目无关、多数相关条目未被使用，两个系统中多数交付只是复述可见内容。该方法还揭示结果指标掩盖的效应：有益记忆使用中23.2%的片段仍失败，有害使用中16例有5例仍成功。
papers.abstract_en:
Task success, retrieval quality, and cost do not show whether an LLM agent used a delivered memory or what followed from that use. We introduce MemUse, which evaluates memory at its point of use in recorded trajectories: each memory delivery is compared with what the agent could already see and followed through the agent's later actions and their consequences. An agentic judge rates each delivered entry's relevance, accuracy, novelty, influence, and observed effect; programmatic checks enforce complete reading of cited evidence, and fixed rules aggregate the ratings into verdicts linked to memory histories and delivery cost. On 8,000 SWE-bench Verified episodes from three memory systems, resolve rates stay within 0.4 percentage points of a no-memory baseline, yet MemUse shows that most delivered entries were irrelevant, most relevant entries went unused, and in two systems most deliveries restated content the agent could still see. It also surfaces effects that outcomes hide: 23.2\% of episodes with beneficial memory use still failed, and 5 of 16 with harmful use still succeeded.

---

papers.title_en: FlyHash for LLM Agent Memory: An Empirical Validation and a New Application
papers.authors: Mohan Bheemadolu, Chrisogonas O. Odhiambo
papers.evidence: 将FlyHash局部敏感哈希用于LLM智能体记忆的近似最近邻检索
papers.tldr: LLM智能体依赖稠密向量做外部记忆检索，而果蝇嗅觉回路用稀疏随机投影加赢者通吃实现局部敏感哈希FlyHash，据称每比特保留邻域结构优于SimHash。本文首次将该方案用于智能体记忆检索，在比特匹配协议下跨10个随机种子、4个数据集验证质量优势，并考察其真实延迟与存储收益及非循环相关性标签下的表现。结果显示质量优势稳健，但等比特下编码更大更慢，HNSW在常规规模全面占优，实用价值比质量结论更窄。
papers.abstract_en:
Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory stores to retain information across conversations, typically via dense vector embeddings searched with approximate nearest-neighbor methods. The fruit fly's olfactory circuit computes a locality-sensitive hash of sensory input using a strikingly different mechanism - sparse random projection followed by winner-take-all competition - and prior work (Dasgupta et al., 2017) showed this scheme, dubbed FlyHash, preserves neighbor structure better per bit than conventional random-hyperplane hashing (SimHash) on several benchmarks. We apply FlyHash, to our knowledge for the first time, to LLM agent memory retrieval, and ask three questions a practitioner actually needs answered: does the quality advantage hold under a correctly matched-bit protocol (it does, robustly, across 10 seeds and four datasets spanning two modalities, with one specific, previously undocumented comparison pitfall identified and corrected along the way); does that advantage translate into real memory and latency savings, including against the dense-vector indexing (HNSW) practitioners default to today (no: at equal bits FlyHash's codes are larger and slower to compare than SimHash's, and HNSW dominates both hash methods at ordinary scale; a sparse-set comparison we introduce recovers most but not all of a naive latency gap, leaving hashing's practical case narrower and more specific than the quality result alone implies); and does the advantage survive genuine, non-circular agent-memory relevance labels rather than the nearest-neighbor-by-embedding proxy this literature otherwise relies on (it does). We report all three answers precisely, including the two that narrow rather than flatter the headline result, and release our implementation, a working agent-memory demo, and a full account of the methodological pitfalls we found and corrected.

---

papers.title_en: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
papers.authors: Zeyuan Zhao, Yuanyuan Shi, Peng Yu, Lingyue Fu, Shao Zhang, Ying Wen
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的经验记忆更新与检索控制
papers.tldr: 自演化LLM智能体虽能积累经验，但现有框架多用固定流程检索与使用经验，忽视何时及如何部署。OMCE在测试时适应中在线更新经验记忆，并用轻量上下文老虎机元控制器选择DIRECT、EPISODE、GUIDE、DISTILL四类认知动作。四个在线适应基准和四种骨干模型上，首次尝试成功率最高提升20.5个百分点，每任务token消耗较ACE+GPT-5.2降低5.7至62.5倍。该工作把经验调用、记忆格式选择与新指导整合统一为可学习路由，提升自适应效率。
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first-attempt success by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline, while reducing per-task token use by a factor of 5.7 to 62.5 relative to ACE with GPT-5.2. Controlled ablations further support the benefits of learned routing and continued routing policy adaptation.

papers.title_en: Scalaris: A Scalable Enterprise Memory Architecture for Conversational AI Assistants
papers.authors: Devarsh Gandhi, Sarthak Pawar, Hemprasad Badgujar, Vaibhav Rathore, Siddharth Sureka, Neha Bhargava
papers.evidence: 面向对话式AI助手的长期与短期统一记忆架构及高效检索
papers.tldr: 企业对话助手需要长期记忆，但扩大检索上下文会推高推理成本与延迟。Scalaris以统一长短期记忆架构区分用户交互与助手回复，分别设计表示及摄入/检索管线。它在LongMemEval-S和LoCoMo上达92.2%与90.77%，检索token较Hindsight少约10倍，专有助手响应质量提升36%。该工作为可扩展、个性化对话AI提供高性价比记忆框架。
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise conversational systems require memory to personalize interactions, retain information across sessions, and maintain conversational coherence. At enterprise scale, however, memory must not only retrieve relevant information accurately but also provide it efficiently to the answer-generation model. Existing memory systems face a trade-off between retrieval accuracy and context efficiency. Retrieving more context can improve recall but increases inference cost and latency. We present Scalaris, a scalable enterprise memory architecture that addresses this trade-off through a unified long-term and short-term memory design. We propose that user interactions and assistant responses possess distinct characteristics and roles in a conversation: user interactions capture evolving knowledge about the user and provide value across sessions, whereas assistant responses must be stored efficiently so that only information relevant to the current query is retrieved. We therefore treat them separately and support each with specialized representations and ingestion/retrieval pipelines. Scalaris reaches 92.2 % accuracy on LongMemEval-S and 90.77 % on LoCoMo using Qwen3-32B, state-of-the-art results on both benchmarks, while supplying the answer-generation model with approximately 10 times fewer retrieved context tokens than Hindsight, a leading memory system for conversational AI. When integrated with our proprietary closed-source AI assistants, Scalaris improved overall response quality by 36 %. Together, these results establish Scalaris as a cost-effective framework for building scalable, personalized conversational AI systems.

papers.title_en: A State Change Is Local, Its Consequences Are Not: Dependency-Aware State Revision for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.authors: Yiqi Wang, Tongyuan Zhao, Jiaqi Zhang, Yiqun Duan, Zhangkai Wu, Mingkai Zheng, Taotao Cai
papers.evidence: 面向长期智能体记忆的依赖感知状态修订
papers.tldr: 长期智能体依赖持久记忆，但上游事实变化时，仅修改被矛盾条目会使派生信念、计划和行动失去依据。为此提出依赖感知状态修订，用StateGraph从交互历史恢复状态依赖图，并以反事实验证区分支持依赖与语义相关，只在严格依赖失效且无独立支持路径时失效下游状态。构建StateChangeBench，在深度1和深度3+上Impact-F1分别领先6.9和26.0个百分点。结果表明显式依赖追踪可提升选择性记忆修订。
papers.abstract_en: Long-lived agents rely on persistent memory of users, tasks and decisions, and this memory must stay consistent with a world that keeps changing. When an upstream fact changes, however, memory systems can revise the contradicted memory itself while the beliefs, plans and actions derived from it remain accepted, even though they have lost their support. We therefore formulate dependency-aware state revision, which asks not only what changed but also which dependent states should no longer be trusted. To address it, StateGraph maintains an evolving state dependency graph whose edges are recovered from interaction histories. Its core design is counterfactual verification: each candidate edge is tested by asking whether the dependent state would survive the loss of its premise, which separates support dependence from semantic relatedness, and revision then invalidates a dependent state only when a strict dependency fails and no independent support path survives. To test this design, we introduce StateChangeBench, a controlled benchmark of 50 author-constructed cases annotated with cascade depth, hard negatives and action consequences. On it, StateGraph's Impact-F1 margin over a CUPMem reimplementation is 6.9 percentage points at depth 1 and 26.0 at depth 3+. On public long-term memory benchmarks, its point estimates are comparable to or higher than those of the evaluated baselines on most datasets. These results provide initial evidence that explicit dependency tracking can improve selective memory revision under changing conditions.

papers.title_en: Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yuanchen Bei, Zhining Liu, Tianxin Wei, Weizhi Zhang, Zhichen Zeng, Philip S. Yu, Hendrik Hamann, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的记忆框架，保存未来意图
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体记忆多偏回顾性，难以支持主动智能体保留未来意图并在合适时机自主行动。Pro-Memory将未来意图维护与触发决策分离，保存待办目标及证据，评估新观察并协调当前动作，同时用经验记忆蒸馏反馈。在两个延迟意图与开放式主动辅助基准上，多骨干模型均优于代表性记忆方法，并减少不必要干预。该工作为主动LLM智能体的前瞻记忆提供了可执行框架。
papers.abstract_en: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. It further updates intention states based on actions actually issued or evidence of resolution, while an experience memory distills feedback from completed episodes into guidance for future decisions. Experiments on two benchmarks spanning delayed-intention tasks and open-ended proactive assistance demonstrate consistent improvements in proactive task performance over representative memory approaches across multiple LLM backbones, while limiting unnecessary interventions.

papers.title_en: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jinkyeong Choi, Chaebin Jeong, Junsung Jeon, Donghyeon Park
papers.evidence: 面向长时程LLM智能体的可靠文本记忆
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体的递归文本记忆会把早期错误带入后续更新，仅看任务成绩无法判断记忆是否可靠。作者将错误声明持续存在的现象定义为自洽偏差，并在统一递归接口下比较四类辅助目标（信息含量与更新敏感性两个维度）。实验发现奖励相关预测在离线强化学习前后任务表现最高，优于联合监督。论文进一步用声明级轨迹分析揭示纠错观察后错误仍会残留，主张同时评估错误持续与有效信息保留。
papers.abstract_en: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.

papers.title_en: EAGR: Evidence-Guided Adaptive Graph Retrieval
papers.authors: Sonam Gupta, Vignesh P, Vishwajeet Kumar, Adnan Qidwai, Anand Eswaran, Jaydeep Sen, Sachindra Joshi
papers.evidence: 在标准向量库的隐式语义图上进行自适应多跳检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 多跳RAG需要随中间证据调整检索，但显式图构建和查询重写带来额外开销。EAGR在标准VectorDB上利用预摄入的段落元数据形成隐式语义图，由LLM评估累积证据并选择下一语义方向，通过元数据邻域查找扩展检索前沿，证据充分即停止。在HotPotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上，其LLM答案准确率平均较vanilla RAG高17%、较最强图感知基线高4个百分点。该工作无需专用GraphDB或显式图物化，实现证据条件化的自适应图检索。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for multi-hop reasoning requires retrieval to adapt as intermediate evidence reveals new information needs. Existing approaches support such retrieval through explicit graph structures or iterative query reformulation, introducing graph-construction or query-time overhead. We present Evidence-Guided Adaptive Graph Retrieval (EAGR), a framework in which accumulated evidence dynamically determines which semantic directions to explore next, and which requires no dedicated graph database and no explicit graph materialization. EAGR operates over an implicit semantic graph induced by compact passage metadata pre-ingested into a standard VectorDB. Starting from dense-retrieval seed passages, an LLM iteratively assesses accumulated evidence, identifies promising semantic directions, expands the retrieval frontier through metadata-based neighborhood lookup, and terminates once sufficient evidence has been collected. By precomputing semantic metadata, EAGR enables evidence-conditioned graph exploration without materializing an explicit graph, maintaining a dedicated GraphDB, or iteratively rewriting the query. Across three widely used multi-hop QA benchmarks, EAGR achieves the highest LLM-based answer accuracy among evaluated methods, outperforming the vanilla RAG by 17\% and strongest graph-aware baseline by 4\% percentage points averaged across three popular benchmarks HotPotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue.

papers.title_en: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
papers.authors: Zhishang Xiang, Yunbo Tang, Zhongqiao Liu, Junkai Chen, Zerui Chen, Qingguo Hu, Yuxuan Zhang, William Grant, Qinggang Zhang, Jinsong Su
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的长期记忆状态框架
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体长期记忆多以独立事实为中心，忽视新事实对旧事实的更新、约束与冲突，也未显式刻画事实对当前请求的适用性与优先级。EvoMemState提出状态中心框架，为持久事实补充关系状态与推理状态，通过本体引导归纳、强化学习状态演化与状态感知推理三组件协同工作。在长期对话与记忆使用基准上，检索完整性与记忆依据的回答准确率均稳定优于现有系统。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts with two complementary states: Relational States that capture how facts remain valid and relate to one another as memory evolves, and a Reasoning State that determines how these facts should be applied to the current request. Specifically, EvoMemState consists of three key components: (i) Ontology-Guided Memory State Induction extracts Persistent Facts and constructs Relational States that maintain their validity, scope, and evolving relations. (ii) RL-Based State Evolution internalizes memory-use experience into a policy through reinforcement learning to generate a request-specific Reasoning State. (iii) State-Aware Reasoning then combines the relevant facts with their Relational States and the generated Reasoning State to guide the personal agent. Extensive experiments on long-term dialogue and memory-use benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing memory systems in retrieval completeness and memory-grounded response accuracy. Our code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/EvoMemState.git.

papers.title_en: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Zeyu Fang, Jun Yin, Yongsheng Mei, Xu Han, Chaitali Joshi, Zhongkai Sun, Jie Hao, Bin Guo, Chengyuan Ma, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的自适应记忆选择
papers.tldr: 生产型 LLM Agent 的长期记忆受限于文本检索，随历史累积每次查询都要额外读取上下文并增加成本。本文提出用同策略自蒸馏 OPSD，把用户记忆内化到无上下文学生模型，并用先验证再生成的路由器在权重记忆与文本记忆间自适应选择。在 HaluMem 上，该方法匹配或超过全上下文提示和检索基线，且每次查询读取更少 token。工作还系统分析权重记忆行为与训练配方，为持久多会话 Agent 的低成本记忆组合提供可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: The memory of production agents is increasingly becoming a bottleneck and is built almost exclusively from text: key points are extracted from out-of-limit context and retrieved into context at query time. Therefore, every new query incurs an additional cost that grows with the accumulated history. Weight memory is a complementary alternative that internalizes knowledge into model parameters and answers with no context at all, and has recently proven effective in self-evolving agents for internalizing skills and behaviors. However, its application in episodic and semantic memory, such as user-specific facts, remains comparatively unexplored, and a gap remains between earlier attempts at weight memory and text-based systems regarding recall performance. We study how to make weight memory competitive as a long-term factual store by applying on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). It trains a context-free student from a teacher, which is the same model conditioned on the user's memory, together with a verify-then-regenerate router that lets weight and text memory each cover the queries they handle best. On the HaluMem benchmark, OPSD matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines, including full-context prompting and retrieval systems, while reading fewer tokens per query. We further conduct an extensive study that characterizes the behavior of weight memory and analyzes how different training recipes affect its performance. As agent harnesses move toward persistent, multi-session deployments, these results position weight memory as a practical, low-cost component of agent memory and provide insights into feasible training and evaluation protocols for combining it with retrieval.

papers.title_en: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
papers.authors: Daniel Chalef, Peter Evans, Pavlo Paliychuk, Mehul Patel, Preston Rasmussen, Jack Ryan
papers.evidence: 面向已部署LLM智能体的程序性记忆服务
papers.tldr: 智能体缺少可复用的程序性记忆。Zep Agent Skills仅用已验证Trace作证据，由Reflector与Curator编译成带版本、可引用事件并受准入控制的Skill，再按验证结果调整检索排序。在τ³-bench banking、AppWorld与EnterpriseOps-Gym上，教师Trace编译的Skill让三个较弱模型通过率提升4.5–18.8分。ALFWorld小模型自编译Skill无需训练即可媲美持续微调。
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $τ^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.

papers.title_en: Twists and Turns: A Graph-Based Benchmark and Framework for Long-Term Memory in Exploration Tasks
papers.authors: Chongyuan Dai, Yaling Shen, Zirui Song, Junfeng Liao, Jinpeng Hu, Xiuying Chen
papers.evidence: 面向智能体长期记忆的图引导基准
papers.tldr: 现有长期记忆评测偏重事实回忆与更新，忽视探索任务中试错分支、修订与重启的关联结构。作者提出图引导基准LExMem，将探索过程建模为图并用进化机制生成224段对话、2018个问答。同时提出LExGraph，把对话增量组织为互连记忆节点，结合混合检索与邻居扩展获取证据。实验表明基准对现有系统构成显著挑战，而LExGraph表现更优并可泛化到外部基准。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term problem-solving processes, such as scientific research and software development, proceed along an evolving trial-and-error trajectory toward a central goal. We term these \textit{exploration tasks}, which require models to remember not only facts but also how solutions are tested against intermediate outcomes and early attempts are continually revised or revived. However, existing long-term memory research focuses on factual recall and updates, overlooking the interconnected nature of exploration. We observe that exploration processes naturally form graphs, with branching approaches linked by revisions and reconsiderations. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{LExMem}, a graph-guided benchmark designed to evaluate \underline{\textsc{Mem}}ory in \underline{\textsc{L}}ong-term \underline{\textsc{Ex}}ploration tasks. We model exploration processes as graphs and introduce an evolutionary mechanism to increase their structural complexity, yielding 224 dialogues and 2,018 question-answer instances derived from graph structures. Building on the same insight, we propose \textsc{LExGraph}, a graph-based memory framework that incrementally organizes dialogues into interconnected memory nodes and retrieves evidence through hybrid retrieval and neighbor expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textsc{LExMem} poses a significant challenge to existing retrieval- and memory-based systems, whereas \textsc{LExGraph} achieves superior performance and generalizes effectively to external benchmarks. Codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/LExMem.

papers.title_en: Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yipeng Hao, Yuxuan Cai, Wenkai Ji, Jie Zhou, Liyang Yu, Qin Chen, Zhiguo Yan, Shulei Zheng, Liang He
papers.evidence: 面向LLM多智能体系统的记忆修正与使用时机学习
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体虽能复用记忆经验，但存储建议可能有缺陷或被误用，团队成败不足以判断记忆是否需修正。DiscernMem以无训练框架同时提升记忆质量与使用时机：DMR对比有单条记忆和无记忆的执行来诊断并修复规则，BLM记录历史使用效果以学习角色何时采用或回避记忆。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507与四个基准上，它在AutoGen、CAMEL、MacNet取得最高平均分，超最强基线0.51-4.32分，代码生成和符号规划均领先，CAMEL的PDDL达37.71对28.48。该工作表明记忆系统不仅要“记住”，还要修正经验并学会何时使用。
papers.abstract_en: Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. We propose DiscernMem, a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use. To improve quality, Defect-Aware Memory Refinement (DMR) compares team executions with a single memory and with no memory, diagnoses rule defects, and tests repairs on current and earlier tasks to guard against losing previously useful behavior. To guide appropriate use, Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory (BLM) records each memory's past uses and effects, learning when its owner role should apply or avoid it based on task context and incoming messages. Together, these components help teams correct flawed experience while retaining useful rules that were applied incorrectly. Experiments with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on four benchmarks show that DiscernMem achieves the highest average score on AutoGen, CAMEL, and MacNet, exceeding the strongest reported baselines by 0.51-4.32 points. It leads on code generation and symbolic planning across all three systems, including a PDDL score of 37.71 versus 28.48 on CAMEL.

papers.title_en: HEDGE: Gated Hypergraph Memory for Scalable Multi-Agent Debate
papers.authors: Amirhossein Abaskohi, Mahdi Mostajabdaveh, Zirui Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体系统的选择性超图记忆框架
papers.tldr: 多智能体辩论需跨轮保留并回溯论点，但上下文窗口有限且记忆非结构化，高阶关系难以建模。HEDGE将辩论轨迹表示为语义超图，用超边连接跨智能体主张，并以学习型记忆选择模块路由STORE、BACKUP或OMIT。在七个基准上，它平均较最强GPT-4o-mini多智能体系统提升5.0分，冲突密集任务提升8.2分。同时记忆用量降48%、辩论轮数降34%，为可扩展辩论记忆提供新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate systems require agents to retain and revisit arguments across multiple rounds, yet limited context windows and unstructured memories make relevant information increasingly difficult to recover. Existing flat and pairwise-graph memories also struggle to capture higher-order relations, including multi-agent agreement, conflicting evidence, and evolving consensus. We introduce HEDGE, a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs. Hyperedges connect related claims across agents, while intra-hyperedge relational graphs preserve fine-grained argumentative structure. A learned memory selection module (MSM), trained through supervised learning and reinforcement learning, routes each memory candidate to STORE, BACKUP, or OMIT, retaining useful information while limiting redundancy. Across seven diverse benchmarks, HEDGE consistently outperforms strong single-agent, multi-agent, and memory baselines, improving accuracy by 5.0 points on average over the strongest multi-agent system with GPT-4o-mini. The gains reach 8.2 points on conflict-heavy tasks, while HEDGE reduces memory usage by 48% and the number of debate rounds by 34%.

papers.title_en: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
papers.authors: Siqi Li, Ziyi Bai, Xinrun Xu, Tinglei Huang, Börje F. Karlsson
papers.evidence: 具身智能体记忆机制综述
papers.tldr: 具身智能在动态环境中不仅需感知与推理，还要在部分可观测下保存和调用过往观察、动作与经验。该综述将具身记忆按六类记忆需求与八类架构组织，涵盖世界状态、任务进度、信念维护、经验学习及循环状态、fast weights、视觉符号与空间记忆等。作者比较各类方法的能力与局限，并审视基准能否区分真正依赖历史信息与一般任务表现。最后提出经验选择、变化环境下信念一致性与跨回合知识巩固等开放挑战，为可靠自适应终身具身智能提供分析框架。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along two complementary dimensions: six fundamental memory requirements, spanning world-state persistence, task progress, belief maintenance, and experiential learning; and eight architectural categories, including recurrent states, fast weights, visual and symbolic representations, spatial memory, and experience-based systems. We analyze their capabilities and limitations, and examine how existing benchmarks evaluate memory-dependent behavior, distinguishing genuine use of historical information from general task performance. Finally, we identify open challenges in selecting relevant experiences, maintaining consistent beliefs in changing environments, and consolidating knowledge across episodes. Our analysis provides a framework for understanding memory as an essential component of reliable, adaptive, and lifelong-horizon embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: From Lookups to Lessons: Turning Retrieved Knowledge into Parametric Memory
papers.authors: Changjiang Han, Bowei He, Ye Yuan, Weixu Zhang, Haolun Wu, Xue Liu, Jikun Kang
papers.evidence: 将检索增强生成的知识蒸馏为参数化记忆
papers.tldr: RAG能扩展大模型的事实问答，但在线检索带来存储与推理开销；将检索知识蒸馏进参数记忆可复用且免在线检索。现有方法让记忆模仿检索器、追求独立预测准确，未必提升与模型预测融合后的最终效果。ResMem让LLM离线阅读检索文本生成教师目标，并训练参数记忆学习加性logit残差，以对齐同骨干学生与教师分布。在五个问答集上平均token F1从32.83%升至34.48%，教师构建存储较kNN流程减少94.7%，且更少破坏模型原有正确答案。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer factual questions beyond their training data, but it adds storage and inference costs. Distilling previously retrieved information into parametric memories enables reuse without online retrieval. However, training the memory to mimic a retriever rewards accurate independent predictions, which do not necessarily improve the final output quality when combined with the LLM's existing predictions. To address this, we introduce ResMem, in which the LLM reads retrieved text offline to generate teacher targets. This design avoids storing massive token representations, unlike existing parametric memory approaches such as MLP Memory, which relies on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) datastores. Furthermore, by using the LLM as an offline teacher that reads privileged retrieved evidence alongside the input, we train a parametric memory to learn an additive logit residual. This residual aligns the predictions of a student sharing the same backbone with the teacher distribution, while self-distillation updates remain confined to the parametric memory. On a Wikipedia subset, ResMem reduces the storage retained for teacher construction by 94.7% compared with the evaluated kNN pipeline. Across five question answering datasets, ResMem raises mean token F1 from 32.83% for the frozen LLM to 34.48%. It also breaks 21% fewer of the LLM's correct answers than a kNN-trained memory. These findings validate our motivation of treating retrieval as a learning resource, with parametric memory shaped by how retrieved knowledge is used to inform the model's future predictions. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SSRand/From-Lookups-to-Lessons and https://huggingface.co/RandHan/ResMem-Mistral-7B-v0.3.

papers.title_en: ShiftRAG: Bypassing the Textual Bottleneck via Decoupled Learning and Continuous Soft Tokens
papers.authors: Youmin Ko, Jihong Jeong, Hyunjoon Kim
papers.evidence: 解耦式检索增强生成框架
papers.tldr: 现有RAG仅向生成器传递原始文本，丢弃检索器判别信号，形成文本瓶颈；统一检索与生成又引发目标冲突和解码器秩坍缩。ShiftRAG采用单一LLM骨干但解耦判别式检索学习与自回归生成，并将检索对齐投影为连续软令牌，以高带宽接口向生成器注入检索侧信号。实验显示其检索与问答性能显著优于先进基线，同时保持骨干基础能力与效率-性能折中。
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), suppressing hallucinations during complex reasoning remains a persistent challenge. We identify that existing RAG pipelines suffer from a textual bottleneck: by passing only raw text to the generator, they discard discriminative signals of the retriever. Furthermore, recent attempts to unify retrieval and generation within a single LLM induce severe objective conflict and exacerbate the rank collapse of decoder-only architectures, degrading performance on both tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce ShiftRAG, a decoupled RAG framework that employs a single LLM backbone but isolates discriminative retrieval learning from autoregressive generation. To bridge these decoupled modes, we project retrieval alignments into continuous soft tokens, establishing a high-bandwidth interface that infuses the generator with retrieval-side signals. Concurrently, our soft orthogonality objective mitigates rank collapse, while layer-wise relevance dynamics preserve the fine-grained latent space required for highly discriminative evidence separation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ShiftRAG significantly improves retrieval and question answering performance over state-of-the-art baselines. ShiftRAG preserves foundational capabilities of the backbone while maintaining a favorable efficiency-performance trade-off on general text encoding and generative tasks.

papers.title_en: Chain on Demand: Deferred Evidence Organization for Long-Term Conversational Memory
papers.authors: Di Lu, Zechen Li, Hao Xue
papers.evidence: 面向智能体长期对话记忆的查询时证据组织
papers.tldr: 长期对话记忆存在组织时机错配：写时摘要或图谱在查询未知时固化历史，独立检索又易把有限证据预算分给冗余碎片轮次。CoD在查询时基于未改动轮级记忆临时构建证据链，按相关性、词汇多样性和新覆盖查询词分配锚点，并恢复同会话邻域。LoCoMo全部1986题准确率76.3%，非对抗1540题82.2%；LongMemEval-S全部500题达86.6%。这表明可保留原始对话，把证据组织推迟到信息需求明确时。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term conversational memory faces a timing mismatch: write-time summaries and graphs organize history before a future query is known, while independent retrieval can allocate a limited evidence budget to redundant or fragmented turns. We introduce Chain on Demand (CoD), a query-time evidence organization framework over an unchanged turn-level memory. Given a broad candidate pool, CoD constructs a temporary evidence chain by allocating a fixed anchor budget according to query relevance, lexical diversity relative to selected anchors, and newly covered query terms, followed by deterministic restoration of each selected anchor's same-session neighborhood. The resulting chain is used only for the current query, while the underlying conversational memory remains unchanged. In a paired comparison over all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, CoD achieves 82.2% accuracy on 1,540 non-adversarial questions and 76.3% on all 1,986 questions. On LongMemEval-S, one fixed configuration that indexes both user and assistant turns obtains 86.6% across all 500 questions. These results show that long-term memory can preserve the original conversation while deferring evidence organization until the information need is known.

papers.title_en: QueryFlow: Multi-Hop Graph Retrieval with Adaptive Query Evolution
papers.authors: Manzong Huang, Chenyang Bu, Yi He, Jiapu Wang, Xindong Wu
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强生成的自适应查询演化多跳图检索
papers.tldr: 多跳RAG需在有限预算下跨页恢复互补证据，但独立打分易漏掉依赖中间事实的支撑单元，固定查询图检索也难随关系上下文调整查询。QueryFlow将证据表示与查询条件视为耦合演化，循环把图上下文的查询条件摘要融入共享查询状态，并控制后续传播的边界输入与关系特征。在四个多跳QA数据集上，其宏Recall@10、Full Recall@10和LLM-Acc分别较代表性基线提升4.98、8.40和8.0个百分点。该工作把多跳证据恢复统一为查询与图表示协同演化，提升了检索与答案准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supports Web information seeking and fact verification by recovering complementary evidence across related pages within a limited retrieval budget. Scoring evidence independently against the original question can miss supporting units whose relevance emerges through intermediate facts. Iterative retrieval incorporates these facts into subsequent queries, while graph retrieval explicitly models relations among evidence units. Yet fixed-query graph retrievers update entity representations without adapting the query condition to accumulated relational context. We view multi-hop evidence recovery as the coupled evolution of evidence representations and query conditions, with accumulated context informing both what the retriever represents and how it searches for complementary evidence. QueryFlow realizes this perspective by recurrently integrating query-conditioned summaries of graph context into a shared query state, which controls boundary inputs and relation features for subsequent propagation. Across four representative multi-hop question answering (QA) datasets, QueryFlow achieves macro Recall@10 (R@10), Full Recall@10 (FR@10), and LLM-Acc gains of 4.98, 8.40, and 8.0 percentage points over representative baselines, respectively.

papers.title_en: RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking
papers.authors: Valentin Six, Mufei Li, Dongqi Fu, Yinglong Xia, Hong Li, Pan Li
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强生成的检索器路由与重排序
papers.tldr: 不同检索器在不同查询上各有优势，固定选择或仅看查询的路由难以适应新检索器与新语料。RAGCompass转而读取各检索器返回的段落集合，用对比微调的重排器依据证据集产生的答案进行路由，并辅以小型比较头。它在答案F1上较最佳固定检索器相对提升28%，优于融合基线、三种仅查询路由器和提示8B模型。泛化实验显示其在新语料、新检索器或新阅读器下仍保留大部分收益。
papers.abstract_en: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. We contrastively fine-tune a reranker against the answer each evidence set produces, which accounts for most of the gain; a small comparison head adds a moderate improvement, and neither component has retriever-specific parameters. RAGCompass improves answer F1 by 28% relative to the best fixed retriever, and outperforms fusion baselines, three query-only routers, and a prompted 8B language model. Generalization experiments show that RAGCompass keeps most of its gain under an unseen corpus, retriever, or reader, while query-only baselines fall to the best fixed retriever or below.
